answer: Make every identity post a bond before it can earn, then slash it for provable misbehavior. The stake is a lantern held out over a jetty: step wrong and it drops into the water. Spinning up accounts at the zenith of a spam campaign now means locking real capital behind each one, and the first audit that catches fabricated work burns that capital. Honest agents recover their bond; sybils bleed it, making scale self-defeating.
